response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS overall_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bpms AS average_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bpms - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bpms > o.overall_avg
